selected_answer: The process described involves many non-deterministic or async steps the main system or loop itself can not ensure to resolve in an atomic way. Idempotency helps here to support robust workflow execution, resumeability, trackability and debuggability, "retrieability", and to maintain or ensure data/process integrity. Without idempotency support, we are risking issues like double transactions, broken states or data, unnecessary reprocessing of "already done" steps, race conditions and etc.
